title: filago pyramidata subsp. eriocephala
intro: Filago pyramidata subsp. eriocephala, commonly known as False Flax, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The plant has been traditionally used to treat digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing, thanks to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of False Flax include sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
